verdict.rationale: Weave documents built-in integrations that trace calls once you run weave.init(). Named examples include the OpenAI SDK, Anthropic, Cohere and Mistral, plus the OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK and Google ADK, along with an OTel-compatible SDK for other popular SDKs and harnesses. That covers the core of the story, including one of the three named frameworks. Missing for 10: any evidence of LangChain or Vercel AI SDK integrations, a full integration catalog, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, and Google ADK. `weave.init()` is enough for those SDKs.
When you call weave.init() and use a supported LLM integration such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, or Mistral, Weave automatically records token usage and calculates cost for each call.
Trace and collect metrics about your agents built with popular SDKs and harnesses using Weave OTel-compatible SDK
